changes_head: Revision history for OpenfMRI dataset ds000117

split.rule: development = the 4 lowest-numbered analysed subjects; confirmation = the other 12; fixed in code before any download (runbook §6.1, design E5)
split.source: ds000117 README (snapshot 2.0.0 and 1.1.0), section "Relationship of Subject Numbering relative to other versions of Dataset": "4. Current OpenNeuro subset N=16 used for (BIDS)" = the FTP subset of N=16 (original subject_01 and subject_06 removed because of bad EEG data, subject_19 because of poor EEG and fMRI data); participants.tsv lists exactly sub-01 ... sub-16 (+ sub-emptyroom).

attribution: Wakeman, D.G. & Henson, R.N. (2015). A multi-subject, multi-modal human neuroimaging dataset. Sci. Data 2:150001, doi:10.1038/sdata.2015.1; OpenNeuro ds000117 (doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds000117.v2.0.0)
